name: Azure Key Vault Key Provider
description: Azure key vault integration with Key module.
project_description: Submodule of Azure Key Vault that wires the azure_key_vault.http_client service into the Key module. It provides a KeyProvider plugin ('Azure Key Vault', id azure_key_vault) that stores and reads Authentication and Encryption keys as vault Secrets and Azure-Encryption keys as vault Keys, and a KeyType plugin ('Azure Encryption', id azure_encryption) that generates RSA keys (2048/3072/4096-bit) directly in the vault. This gives site builders a GUI, via the Key module, for managing vault-backed secrets and keys instead of calling the service in code.
